_doc: Reference of make run-analyze LOG=logs/W4.events.txt SPEC=specs/wcet_e_tt.json (rttools.paper.wcet run-log): run W4, wcet_e of tag r11-rc9 (git archive of commit 8e116db; with the release by tick (RELEASE_MASK=15, release=tick), the UCX-OS kernel without nested interrupts (isr=no_nesting), the crt0.s with the return test of _isr and the read back of _interrupt_set(0) (crt0=guard_readback) and the time-triggered injection of the packets between PEs (injection=tt; table app/wcet_e_tt.h with t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v) of the image), costs=max_csv_static costs_file=wcet_e.json)), Questa 2025.3, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0, on the GAPH server, 2026-10-15, 10.5 ms at 500 MHz (run_r11g.sh: make -C experiments/wcet sim F_CLK=500000000 SIM_NS=10500000 BUILD=build/w4); static t(v) of the image of the run (logs/W4.image.elf) against the CPU time of each PE and task, and the analysis of rtlapp with the model of the run (rtlapp). Model of the run (the defaults of rttools): the network interface of each PE as a resource of the link schedule, o_i = L0 + 20 (m + 1) + w_NI (w_NI = 15169), and t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v)) of the costs file of RUN_INFO (experiments/wcet/costs/tt), the deadline of each packet at the release tick of its reader and the finish of each job with the handlers of the packet events of its PE (deadline=tick in RUN_INFO); tt: each packet against s_{i,j}, o_i and its deadline, each job end against F(v), each enqueue against s_{i,j}, each arrival against the start of its reader (rttools/paper/ttcheck.py).

tt.model: o_i = L0 + w_h (m + 1) + w_NI; tau = tick of the phase of the sending job
